drafts.text: A few years ago I started a nonprofit, Empowering Change, to ask a simple question: how do we use data for good? Practical Solutions is the latest answer: an AI that looks for bright spots, places where something works, and shows people how to do it too. ultrastable.org
drafts.long: A few years ago I started a nonprofit, Empowering Change, around one question: how can data serve the common good? That led to years of research at QNFO, then to AI for good. Now it runs for real. Ultrastable is a platform that keeps its own loops going, and Practical Solutions on top of it looks for bright spots, evidence-backed solutions to pressing problems that people can actually implement. If you work on a problem like that, I'd love to hear which one. ultrastable.org
